svg.title: Payroll runs: generated, reviewed, approved, exported — SoftTrack web design mockup (#132)
svg.desc: A run is generated for a period and schedule from active people and the compensation in effect. People with no compensation are listed as missing. Draft lines take adjustments with a note; approval freezes amounts; the CSV export is the product.
svg.text: Payroll runs: generated, reviewed, approved, exported
· SoftTrack keeps the record and the CSV; it computes no tax and pays nobody
Finance → Payroll runs → September 2026, in draft

g.text: Monthly · 1–30 Sep 2026 · generated by Grace Mensah, 26 Sep
2 people have no compensation for this period
and are on the run as missing, not skipped: Ben
freezes the lines. Export CSV waits
for it: the export is the product, the run is its
fewer people than work here is the worst kind
In draft, a line takes a one-off adjustment, and
The two missing people are lines too, at the
bottom, until someone records their pay.
Totals per currency, side by side. Never one

svg.text: A payrollrun (period, schedule, state, approved by/at) and its lines, generated from active employees and the compensation in effect. State is draft → approved → paid, set by a
finance admin, for the reason sprint state is set. Approval freezes amounts onto the lines. No payment execution, bank integrations or tax tables: the export feeds the system that
